commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connectors faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin: /Repair Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connectors
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Door Control Module(s)
technicalNotes:
This fault code describes that the Convenience System Data Bus is operating in Single Wire mode.
You can Kontrol edin: the door control modules by disconnecting all of them and reconnecting them one after another, while checking the comfort system meas. blocks regarding the data bus status.
